subject: Web Development
title: 60 Frames Per Second
description: Learn 60 Frames Per Second in one minute.

hook.text: Smooth scrolling and animation require the browser to paint a new frame every 16 milliseconds.

buildup.text: That's 60 frames per second. Miss the deadline and the user sees jank — a visible stutter.

discovery.text: The browser must run JavaScript, calculate layout, and paint all within that 16ms budget.

twist.text: Heavy JavaScript can eat the entire budget, leaving zero time for painting.

climax.text: Developers optimize for 60fps like filmmakers optimize for frame rates in cinema.

punchline.text: Sixteen milliseconds is all you get per frame.

quiz.question: How many milliseconds does each frame get at 60fps?
